### Claim boundaries / 主张边界
- [ ] Synthetic or benchmark results are not presented as real-world efficacy.
- [ ] New numbers include sample, conditions, source and limitations.
- [ ] No real learner, family, health, beneficiary or institution-identifiable data.
- [ ] Target architecture and research hypotheses are clearly labeled.
